title: A font or document in the private Library bucket is not a signed-out download by default

source.ref: Meta scan eight (2026-10-12), Library review of #3200 (LIVE-692).

detail: FILED 2026-10-12. THE CONSEQUENCE: library_assets.download_policy defaults to 'open', the Studio upload never sets a policy for a library-files row, effectiveDownloadPolicy tightens 'open' only for protected assets, and protectRefusal refuses to protect a library-files asset. So the download door signs a URL for a signed-out caller with the asset id, though the bucket exists because a font licence usually forbids a public link and a document is often internal. A test (download-door.test.ts, 'signs an unprotected document from the private library-files bucket') pins today's behaviour, so the change needs the owner's word. THE FIX: insert library-files rows with download_policy 'staff', or treat 'open' as 'staff' for that bucket in effectiveDownloadPolicy.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';if(!/LIBRARY_FILES_BUCKET/.test(r('lib/library/download-door.ts'))&&!/downloadPolicy: 'staff'|download_policy: 'staff'/.test(r('app/(main)/admin/library/actions.ts')+r('lib/library/store.ts'))){console.error('SCAN-836: a library-files upload is an open download by default');process.exit(1)}"
